word: And that is as it should be, because death is very likely the single best invention of life.
meaning: 而這就是應該有的樣子，因為死亡很可能是生命最偉大的發明。
example: He argues that death is not the enemy of life but its most important feature.
hint:
中文解釋：顛覆性的觀點——死亡不是悲劇，而是生命運作最核心的機制。
1) as it should be (phr.): 就應該是這樣；syn: the way it is meant to be; ant: a mistake
2) invention of life (phr.): 生命的發明；syn: life's greatest feature; ant: life's flaw
pronunciation: Philosophical: that is as it SHOULD be | death is VERY LIKE-ly | the BEST in-VEN-tion of LIFE.

example: Death is what drives change and renewal in the world.
hint:
中文解釋：「change agent」是管理學術語——能夠推動改變的力量。死亡就是讓生命持續更新的驅動力。
1) change agent (n.): 變革推手；syn: driver of change; ant: force of stagnation
2) life's (poss.): 生命的；syn: of life; ant: death's
pronunciation: Punchy: It's LIFE'S change A-gent. (short, confident)

word: It clears out the old to make way for the new.
meaning: 它清除舊的，為新的騰出空間。
example: Death removes what is old so that new things can take their place.
hint:
中文解釋：死亡的功能就是「新陳代謝」——讓世界不斷更新、前進。
1) clears out (phr.): 清除；syn: removes; ant: preserves
2) make way for (phr.): 為…騰出空間；syn: give room to; ant: block
pronunciation: Natural rhythm: it CLEARS OUT the OLD | to MAKE WAY for the NEW.

word: Right now, the new is you.
example: At this moment, the graduating students are the new generation taking the world forward.
hint:
中文解釋：直接對應畢業生——你們就是那個「新的」，充滿無限可能。
1) right now (phr.): 此時此刻；syn: at this moment; ant: in the past
2) the new (phr.): 新的（代際）；syn: the next generation; ant: the old
pronunciation: Direct: Right NOW | the NEW | is YOU. (each word equally weighted)

word: But someday, not too long from now, you will gradually become the old and be cleared away.
meaning: 但有一天，在不久的將來，你們也會慢慢成為舊的，然後被清除。
example: He reminds them honestly that they too will eventually be replaced by the next generation.
hint:
中文解釋：不留情面的提醒——今天的「新」，終將成為明天的「舊」，這是自然規律。
1) gradually (adv.): 逐漸地；syn: slowly; ant: suddenly
2) cleared away (phr.): 被清除；syn: removed; ant: preserved
pronunciation: Honest: some-DAY | not TOO LONG from NOW | you will GRAD-u-al-ly be-come the OLD | and be CLEARED a-WAY.

word: Sorry to be so dramatic, but it's quite true.
meaning: 很抱歉說得這麼誇張，但這確實是真的。
example: He acknowledges his statement sounds harsh, but insists it is simply the truth.
hint:
中文解釋：幽默地緩和了前一句的沉重語氣，展現 Jobs 演講的獨特節奏——沉重後的一抹輕鬆。
1) dramatic (adj.): 誇張的、戲劇性的；syn: intense; ant: mild
2) quite true (phr.): 確實是真的；syn: absolutely correct; ant: not really
pronunciation: Dry humor: SOR-ry to be so dra-MAT-ic | but it's QUITE true.

word: Your time is limited, so don't waste it living someone else's life.
meaning: 你的時間是有限的，所以不要把它浪費在過別人的人生上。
example: Because life is short, he urges them not to spend it following someone else's path.
hint:
中文解釋：最廣為引用的金句之一——提醒人要活出自己，而非活在他人的期待中。
1) limited (adj.): 有限的；syn: finite; ant: unlimited
2) someone else's life (phr.): 別人的人生；syn: others' expectations; ant: your own life
pronunciation: Urgent: your TIME is LIM-it-ed | don't WASTE it | LIV-ing SOME-one ELSE'S life.

word: Don't be trapped by dogma, which is living with the results of other people's thinking.
meaning: 不要被教條所束縛，因為教條是活在別人思維的結果之中。
example: He warns against following fixed beliefs blindly, as they are just the conclusions of other people's minds.
hint:
中文解釋：「dogma」（教條）是對「別人的思維框架」的形象化描述——要用自己的頭腦思考。
1) trapped (v.): 被困住；syn: constrained; ant: freed
2) dogma (n.): 教條、硬性規定；syn: rigid belief; ant: open thinking
pronunciation: Warning: Don't be TRAPPED by DOG-ma | which is LIV-ing with the RE-sults | of OTH-er peo-ple's THINK-ing.
